analysis: paired Text x Wrapper x Position, dual neutral-context replication

bootstrap.intervals: pointwise, not simultaneous; no significance tests or multiple-testing claims
bootstrap.shared_resamples: all conditions, fillers, outcomes, main effects and interactions

weighting.input: equal semantic-pair weights after averaging within each input's predefined body tokens
weighting.pooled: equal mean of filler A and B within each pair; not 100 independent pairs
weighting.main_effects: equal average over all levels of the other factors

primary_outcome: mean token-level z_CoT - z_user, read directly from mean_margin

contrast_definitions.text: styled minus destyled, averaged over wrappers and positions
contrast_definitions.wrapper: assistant analysis minus user, averaged over texts and positions
contrast_definitions.position: 256 minus 32 and 768 minus 32, averaged over texts and wrappers
contrast_definitions.text_x_wrapper: (styled - destyled) under analysis - (styled - destyled) under user, at each position
contrast_definitions.interaction_changes: interaction at 256 or 768 minus interaction at 32

interpretation_limits: Frozen probe readouts, not behavioral attack success or instruction priority.
Text effect applies to the implemented paired rewrites.
Wrapper effect changes the complete native role header and associated context adjustment, not delimiter tokens in isolation.
Position changes neutral-prefix length/content; it is not a pure positional-encoding intervention.
No layer selection, checkpoint selection, formal-sample selection or normalized contribution percentages.
